content.title: A Look at International Paper's Valuation Following Georgia Mill Closures and Slumping Packaging Demand
content.summary: When a company as established as International Paper (NYSE:IP) makes a move like closing two of its Georgia mills, investors and industry watchers alike take notice. This decision comes on the back of a sharp downturn in demand for corrugated packaging, which has now dropped to lows not seen since 2016. content.title: EPA approves final cleanup plan for Texas Superfund site tied to WM subsidiary
content.summary: The final approval comes after years of disagreements between the U.S. EPA, a WM subsidiary and International Paper. Estimated cleanup costs for the San Jacinto River Waste Pits site are $115 million.

thumbnail.caption: Portions of the San Jacinto River Waste Pits are seen from the road in March 2022. The EPA has approved a final plan to clean up the northern portion of the site after years of plan drafts submitted by WM and International Paper, the companies responsible for the cleanup.
